race.description: Pink Ribbon Race Day 11th October Hcp (Bm55)
race.comment: LAZENBY (1) registered a strong win at this track two runs ago. Fair effort last time out when seventh over 1250m at this venue, beaten 2 lengths after making up late ground. Ryan Wiggins is a key engagement and is nicely placed to play a pivotal role. TARIFF (7) strips fitter second-up from the spell and is capable of sharp improvement. Top-three candidate. FANCY GARTER (8) has placed two from three around this circuit and maps ideally from gate two. In the mix. SHOWN THE DOOR (10) missed the frame two back but was a lot better last time when second over 1250m at this track. Can feature on best.
